en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a small Italian square framed by historic buildings. On the left is a grand arched portal of a palazzo with rusticated stonework. A café terrace with tables and awning stands nearby. On the right, several multi‑storey buildings feature shuttered windows; one façade bears a large slogan painted in block letters. Street‑level shops include a patisserie/café, and an old car is parked near the center where two children stand. The postcard caption at the bottom identifies the location.
